Let me start by looking at the codebase.
I found the cause of the SUSPECT bug and fixed it. I haven't run the fix, because the project's dependencies aren't installed here, so tests and the type-check wouldn't run. Please try it in a practice match.

## The bug
When you call SUSPECT, the reveal animation pauses the bot simulation. When it resumed, the simulation tried to catch up on all the paused time in one go. Every bot then ran through its decisions at once, so they all fired SUSPECT together. This happened when you suspected first because your reveal was the pause that triggered it. The overlapping calls also made your team's SUSPECT counter look used up.

The fixes:
- **Skipped time:** [`stepTo` in local-match.ts](https://github.com/divo662/jackpot-ng/blob/main/src/lib/bot/local-match.ts) now skips paused time instead of replaying it.
- **One call at a time:** Once any bot calls SUSPECT, the others' pending calls are dropped and the simulation stops stepping for that tick.
- **Cooldown:** A new [`cancelPendingSuspect`](https://github.com/divo662/jackpot-ng/blob/main/src/lib/bot/agent.ts) method resets that bot's cooldown after its pending call is dropped.

## Bot ratings
These ratings come from each bot's stats in [archetypes.ts](https://github.com/divo662/jackpot-ng/blob/main/src/lib/bot/archetypes.ts), not from playtesting.

| Bot | Rating | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Strategist | 9/10 | Strongest all-round bot. Very good at reading signals (90), excellent teamwork (90), and patient (88), so it rarely calls SUSPECT wrongly. A bit passive at attacking. |
| Hawk | 8.5/10 | Best at reading opponents (98) and aggressive (75). It's the most dangerous opponent, but it has weak deception (35) and its timing is only average (65). |
| Loyalist | 7.5/10 | Best partner (teamwork 98) and patient. Weak as an opponent because it's passive (35) and rarely catches you. |
| Trickster | 7/10 | Highest deception (95), so it produces lots of fake signals. Its patience is low (40), so it makes mistakes. |
| Gambler | 5.5/10 | Very aggressive and risky (95) with low patience (25). It will often burn its SUSPECT calls on false alarms. Fun but sloppy. |
| Chaos | 5/10 | Deceptive (85) and aggressive (80) but reckless (patience 20). It's the weakest as a partner. |

**Difficulty levels:** Hard reads gestures best, reacts fastest, and uses card counting. It suspects with 85% probability above a 0.75 confidence threshold. Normal is a fair middle level. Easy misses 28% of partner signals and rarely suspects. The gap between levels is clear. On Hard, Gambler and Chaos still feel beatable, while Hawk and Strategist feel tough.

**Possible tweak:** Loyalist and Hawk could use more variety. I can tune the weaker bots if you want.
